Messages.Body:
Can you use a number of Couriers to "mill" a card, then view the next and mill that card and so on? Seems to me that all the Couriers would see the same card and discard the same card.

Courier
Type: Ally
Requires: Nosferatu antitribu
Cost: 2 blood
Mortal with 1 life. 0 strength, 1 bleed.
Courier gets -1 intercept when attempting to block a vampire. When a minion you control successfully bleeds, you may look at the top card of the library of the Methuselah being bled, and you may tap the Courier to discard that card.

Peter Bakija actually had a deck that ran several of these to mill a deck, and provide some ousting power. Look for "You, two girls! On the bike!"

I had a mill deck concept before to make a deck out of Couriers, Destructive Secrets, Feline Saboteurs. Even during creation, the deck seemed to have too many moving parts and too little oust.

If you do come up with a deck after this, kindly post it. Would love to see it.
